notes.title: Launch option fix
notes.content:
A recent update of the game was causing some issues at launch as it was trying to launch the game with a bad name.
This has now been fixed and I apologize fot that.

notes.title: Version 1.0.0 published !
notes.content:
Hello Everyone,

Absolute VR Experiences is now released in version 1.0.0 and with 15% off for a week.

Thanks again to early access supporters !
